title: Manager brief — draft updates & evidence log
content:
Quick purpose: a compact, evidence-backed update for my manager meeting. This is rough — will prune to 1 page.

Top 3 outcomes (last 6 months) — 1-2 lines each + supporting evidence:
- Reduced new hire ramp-to-first-PR from ~28 days -> ~19 days (pilot of buddy+task-bundles). Evidence: onboarding cohort metrics (HR-4821), sample task templates attached in Confluence.
- Launched manager calibration rubric (pilot with Eng infra & DevEx leads) — improved calibration agreement score from 0.58 -> 0.76 in pilot group. Evidence: calibration-pilot-summaries, recorded session 2026-01-12.
- Improved onboarding NPS (voluntary survey) from 6.8 -> 7.9 (n=63). Evidence: pulse-survey-sheet, raw responses linked.

Impact back-of-envelope (why it matters):
- Faster ramp reduces hiring OTE cost by ~2.5% per engineer (conservative). Back-of-envelope calc in Confluence.
- Better manager calibration reduces variance in promotion decisions = fewer appeals + faster reviews.

What I did (high level activities):
- Ran three 90-min manager training workshops (materials: confluence/manager-training-90).
- Built and iterated on onboarding task-bundles with Eng/SE hiring managers (ticket HR-4821).
- Instrumented onboarding metrics in analytics (small dashboard) — collecting weekly cohort snapshots.

Concrete evidence snippets (copy these into the brief if needed):
- Jan 14 cohort: first-PR median = 18 days, mean = 21.6, sample PR link: github.com/rw-inference/pr/726.
- Calibration pilot note: "Agreement increased after introducing rubric + 30-min anchored discussion" — see pilot-notes.odt (Confluence).
- NPS sample quote: 'Buddy tasks made ramp tangible — felt helpful vs vague ramp docs' — survey response ID S-2026-01-24-7.

Areas I want to be explicit about (ask/decision items for manager):
1) Headcount ask (Q3): need +0.5 FTE (contractor -> perm) to scale onboarding and run continuous calibration across larger teams. Rationale and small plan attached.
2) Promotion pipeline support: ask for prioritized support from Eng leads to fast-track calibration for SE II -> III and M1 -> M2 cohorts next cycle.
3) Budget ask (training materials): ~$6k for external facilitation for manager workshops (two sessions).

Questions for manager (short):
- Do you want this to be positioned as org-wide 'onboarding acceleration' or kept as a cross-functional pilot for now?
- Priority on headcount vs external facilitation spend?
- Any stakeholders you want looped in pre-announce (execs/Finance)?

Open risks / unknowns (how we plan to mitigate):
- Risk: scaling buddy program without enough stable volunteers -> burnout. Mitigation: rotating schedule + small stipend (proposal linked).
- Risk: promotion calibration might highlight inequities we need to address publicly. Mitigation: anonymized calibration reports and action plan.

Next steps (my plan before manager meeting):
- Trim this doc to 1 page TL;DR (by 2026-03-03).
- Attach the two most compelling data snippets (cohort metrics + NPS) as visuals.
- Draft a 30s opening script explaining why this matters to product velocity.
- Share draft with Elena for feedback (by 2026-03-02).

Notes-to-self / scratchlines (informal):
- Keep numbers conservative — manager likes conservative ROI.
- Highlight one concrete story (new hire "C" traction) — humanize the metric.
- If asked about scale: propose phased rollout (teams -> org).

Misc quick links (paste into brief where appropriate):
- Pilot metrics sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-onboarding-cohorts
- Calibration pilot notes: https://confluence.company/space/POPS/pilot-calibration-jan
- JIRA ticket for program: https://jira.company/browse/HR-4821

Bottom line sentence (for top of brief):
- "Small operational changes (task-bundles + manager rubric) reduced ramp time and improved calibration agreement; with modest investment we can scale to deliver measurable hiring ROI and fewer review cycles."

Unresolved: whether to position the headcount ask as people-ops-only or as shared investment with Eng Ops. Hold decision for manager.

End of scratchpad. Will convert to final manager slide/one-pager before the meeting.
